summary: Day 45 of 72 (Geometry Triangles 1: Angles, Inequalities & Triplets): Master sum of angles, exterior angle theorem, triangle inequality (|a-b| < c < a+b), and Pythagorean triplets.

urgent_alerts.title: CAT 2026 Admit Card Release
urgent_alerts.action: Download CAT 2026 admit card on iimcat.ac.in (expected early Nov, verify on iimcat.ac.in). Note allocated slot (Slot 1, 2, or 3), and align mock tests with slot timing.

blocks.title: DSA Algorithmic Problem Solving (2 Problems)
blocks.details: Solve 2 curated LeetCode problems (1 Medium + 1 Easy/Review) from the 247-problem DSA Tracker. Focus on algorithmic clarity and edge cases.

blocks.title: Dedicated Job Outreach Application Batch
blocks.details: Dedicated morning batch: Submit 8–10 tailored applications on Instahyre and LinkedIn Jobs. Target Series A–C tech and European remote roles highlighting Immediate Joiner status.

blocks.title: CAT Day 45: QA & DILR Focus
blocks.details: QA: 25 Questions on Triangles basics: Finding angles, allowable integer third side counts, and obtuse/acute angle tests.. DILR: Radar Charts & Bubble Scatter Plots: Interpreting multi-axis spider charts and bubble radii. Anastasis Set 30..

blocks.title: Germany Academic Admin & Prerequisite Audits
blocks.details: Zero-fee audit tasks: Check Anabin H+ status for MDU, audit dMAT status on aps-india.de/dmat, review Passau interactive guide checklist, and email MDU for 100% English MOI letter.

blocks.title: CAT Day 45: VARC & Verbal Ability
blocks.details: CL MyZone VARC: RC Module 8 - Literature & Historical Narrative passages. Solve 2 passages (8 Qs) in 18 mins. Maintain error log on Career Launcher MyZone.
